title: BR-02 PlayCanvas startup storage status

requirements: Probe storage before createSliceState, initial HUD render, or save writes.
Missing, inaccessible, or failed read/write storage shows exact SESSION ONLY status before interaction while gameplay remains usable in memory.
Healthy storage hides the warning and preserves existing save/load behavior.
The probe does not mutate PLAYCANVAS_SAVE_KEY and leaves no probe key after successful cleanup.
A later save-key write failure shows SESSION ONLY without throwing through restartAndStart().
The warning remains visible in menu and gameplay, including mobile layout.

assertions: Failed-storage cases showed the initial warning.
Healthy storage kept the initial warning hidden and loaded the seeded save.
The seeded save value was unchanged by probing.
No probe key remained after probe cleanup.
restartAndStart() exercised the save-key write failure; SESSION ONLY appeared without an escaping exception.

boot_recovery_smoke.desktop: failure restored, stale callback ignored, Retry reloaded route
boot_recovery_smoke.touch: failure restored, Retry reloaded route, module status 200

production_build.note: Vite reported the existing large-chunk advisory; build completed successfully.

known_limit: If storage permanently denies removeItem after accepting a probe write, the application cannot guarantee removal. It retries cleanup, verifies absence, and treats persistent residue as failed acceptance.
